commit.message:
Restrict the accepted palette to figures and restore plain page styling

Apply the author's figure-only palette acceptance. Keep GitHub-native pages in default GitHub formatting and replace the optional HTML site's painting-inspired chrome with neutral white surfaces, system fonts, standard links and no decorative mark.

Preserve all figure SVG bytes and color mappings, all canonical scientific documents, numerical inputs and approved exports. Regenerate the affected reading pages and their manifest. The uploaded tree matches the checked local blobs.

Reader-site CI 34223404638 passed full rebuild, native regeneration, existing/new tests and real local HTTP browser checks. Scientific integrity/figure reproduction passed in 34223404538; its unchanged complete-certificate job is separately tracked and was still running at this merge. No numerical code was changed. No deployment, privacy/license change, manuscript or old-repository edit.
